title: What is Traffic Mirroring: A Complete Guide
summary: Ensuring seamless data flow and robust application performance is crucial in modern networking and cloud computing.
body_text: Ensuring seamless data flow and robust application performance is crucial in modern networking and cloud computing. Traffic mirroring enables enhanced network observability, allows for effective troubleshooting, and facilitates the testing of new features without interrupting live traffic. It captures and replicates network traffic, providing a powerful solution for maintaining and optimizing network operations. This guide provides a clear overview of traffic mirroring, explaining how it functions within the AWS ecosystem and why it’s important for cloud environments. We’ll cover the benefits, use cases, and potential challenges of traffic mirroring, giving you a thorough understanding of this essential networking tool. What is Traffic Mirroring? Traffic mirroring sounds straightforward—it involves capturing network traffic and replicating it to another location. In local networking, this is often called port mirroring or a network tap, but in web applications, this is commonly referred to as traffic capture and replay. While the process is deceptively simple, doing it right can get complex. Traffic mirroring is a versatile tool used for performance optimization, security threat analysis, application development, debugging, user sentiment analysis, and behavior tracking. Unlike logging, which generally provides call-related information, traffic mirroring gives you a comprehensive overview of the entire ecosystem and application. How Traffic Mirroring Works Traffic mirroring captures network traffic and replays it in controlled environments for testing or further analysis. This approach allows developers to model real-world traffic on services without the risks or resource use associated with production environments, enabling realistic testing scenarios with minimal overhead. To set up a traffic mirroring session, start by identifying the traffic mirror source and decide how to filter the traffic effectively for your testing needs. This typically requires a bit of oversight and planning, especially when trying to figure out what you’re actually testing for. For example, if you’re largely interested in security data, it doesn’t make much sense to capture only the data for a single endpoint - you’ll want a more broad base data source, and thus, a more general capture. For feature-specific testing, you can select a tighter inbound and outbound rules for traffic capture, though this narrows the test scope to that specific data alone. A well-executed session involves configuring the collection point and ensuring that the mirrored data accurately represents your traffic mirror source. This will require setting your collection point, deciding on capturing traffic pre, post, or regardless of authentication and authorization status. By configuring your session carefully, you can gather insightful data without overburdening your resources. After collecting your data, choosing the right solution is crucial. Tools like Speedscale let you capture and replay data into your system, using real production traffic for accurate development and testing. With numerous traffic replay solutions available, prioritize one that is both proven and trusted. Since this solution will handle your valuable traffic data, it’s essential to select a solution like Speedscale that can assure effectiveness and safety. Traffic Mirroring in the AWS Ecosystem Amazon Web Services (AWS) has integrated traffic mirroring capabilities into its cloud offerings, enabling users to monitor and analyze traffic within their virtual private clouds (VPCs). AWS Traffic Mirroring allows users to mirror traffic from Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) within their EC2 instances through filtering rules, which determine the packets to be monitored. By configuring the ENI as a traffic mirror source, AWS ensures that mirrored data is captured from precisely the intended point in your architecture. From here, you can forward the traffic to a designated traffic mirror target for analysis or storage. The advantage of using Speedscale is its flexibility; you’re not limited to only the default settings or a rigid, complex solution. It integrates smoothly with EC2 and AWS, bringing together native AWS traffic capture and Speedscale’s replay feature. AWS Traffic Mirroring lets you filter specifically which packets to mirror for analysis. Combined with a network or gateway load balancer, this arrangement guarantees efficient traffic distribution and analysis across different endpoints. Use Cases of Traffic Mirroring Traffic mirroring has numerous applications across industries and use cases, including: Performance Monitoring: Analyze traffic patterns and identify bottlenecks to optimize application performance. Security Analysis: Detect and investigate malicious activities by inspecting mirrored traffic. Monitor outbound traffic for unauthorized data exfiltration or other malicious activities. Testing and Debugging: Test new features or updates in a simulated environment without affecting production traffic. Compliance Audits: Capture and store network traffic logs to meet regulatory requirements. Incident Response: Facilitate rapid investigation of network issues or security breaches by providing granular traffic insights. Traffic Mirroring in Cloud Environments In cloud environments, traffic mirroring becomes even more critical due to the distributed nature of workloads and the reliance on virtualized infrastructure. Key aspects of traffic mirroring in the cloud include: Scalability: Cloud-native mirroring solutions scale seamlessly with dynamic workloads. In large-scale deployments, using a network load balancer can help distribute the load from mirrored traffic, ensuring no single resource is overwhelmed. Integration: Direct integration with cloud services like AWS Traffic Mirroring and Azure Network Watcher. Cost Efficiency: Cloud providers often offer pay-as-you-go pricing for traffic mirroring features, ensuring cost-effective deployment. Automation: Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to automate the configuration and deployment of traffic mirroring setups. Benefits of Traffic Mirroring Traffic mirroring unlocks a ton of benefits for organizations looking to intelligently enhance their network and application performance & operations. Enhanced Observability First and foremost, traffic mirroring unlocks a detailed view of network activity that is highly useful for troubleshooting and decision-making. By capturing network traffic from the traffic mirror source, you can thoroughly inspect trends and patterns that suggest areas for improvement or require further analysis. With tools that monitor mirrored traffic, you can gain granular insights into the ecosystem, enabling informed decision-making. Seamless Testing Traffic mirroring allows you to test and validate new features in a non-intrusive way using actual production traffic. A traffic mirror session provides realistic data for validating tests while reducing the likelihood of end-user disruptions that could harm your reputation and product sentiment. By leveraging your traffic mirror target, you can ensure that captured traffic is used efficiently for replay and iteration. Guided Development Traffic mirroring enhances your development environment with valuable insights, much like it improves testing. By capturing traffic via a network load balancer or other scalable system, you create a body of data that can be analyzed for end-consumer needs. This process enables developers to validate user sentiment without directly polling users, reducing survey fatigue and improving the overall development experience. Improved Security Traffic mirroring surfaces potential vectors for attack by capturing network traffic and replaying it for analysis. It can even identify probing attacks or scanning attempts indicative of incoming threats. Proactively identifying these issues at the traffic mirror source can enable real-time threat detection and response, reducing overall risk. Additionally, monitoring outbound traffic within mirrored sessions ensures that sensitive data isn’t being exfiltrated by malicious actors. Increased Reliability This process also improves application reliability by surfacing potential issues long before they impact end users. The ability to monitor traffic from a robust traffic mirror session ensures early identification of performance bottlenecks, configuration errors, or unforeseen application behavior. While these benefits enhance security and development, they also significantly boost user trust. Applications that evolve and improve seamlessly without frequent disruptions are more likely to gain adoption and loyalty compared to those that suffer from downtime during each iteration. Challenges in Traffic Mirroring Traffic mirroring is not without challenges. While these issues can be effectively navigated with careful planning and execution, organizations must be mindful of resource usage, scalability, and cost to deploy necessary solutions effectively. Resource Overhead Mirroring traffic can significantly increase network and storage usage, especially in environments with high traffic volumes. For example, capturing network traffic from a traffic mirror source across multiple endpoints may consume additional bandwidth and processing power. The problem worsens when the mirrored traffic is kept for long durations or subjected to in-depth analysis. To mitigate this, organizations can configure traffic mirror sessions to filter unnecessary data, ensuring only relevant information is captured and replayed. Cost Implications Traffic capture can become costly if not set up correctly. The need for additional infrastructure, such as a traffic mirror target or supporting systems like a network load balancer, may introduce unexpected expenses. Cloud-based solutions help alleviate some of these costs through scalable and pay-as-you-go pricing models. However, organizations must evaluate their specific needs carefully and adopt traffic mirror filters to minimize unnecessary data capture and storage expenses. Scalability Concerns Legacy systems and on-premises hardware often struggle to handle the dynamic nature of traffic mirroring. For instance, a traffic mirror session designed for small-scale testing may become overwhelmed when applied to high-traffic environments. This is where scalable cloud solutions, such as those integrated with AWS or Azure, come into play. Leveraging a network load balancer ensures that mirrored traffic is distributed efficiently across the system, avoiding bottlenecks and maintaining overall performance. Complexity in Configuration Configuring a traffic mirror session can be complex, particularly when deciding which traffic mirror source to use, what traffic to mirror, and how to apply traffic mirror filters effectively. Misconfiguration can lead to incomplete or irrelevant data being captured, reducing the utility of the mirrored traffic. Understanding your organizational goals, whether they relate to security, performance testing, or compliance, is crucial due to this complexity. Conclusion Traffic mirroring is an incredibly powerful tool for optimizing your application performance, bolstering your service security, and improving your network observability. With the right tools, you can monitor mirrored traffic effectively, ensuring that your traffic mirror session delivers actionable insights. While traffic mirroring does present some challenges, leveraging the correct solution can mitigate much of this. Speedscale is a versatile and cost-effective solution for traffic mirroring, suitable for both large and small-scale applications. It enables you to capture and replay traffic from diverse sources efficiently. Getting started with Speedscale is quick and easy; you can start a free trial with a full month of enterprise features in just minutes!

ARC Prize Foundation - a North Star for AGI
summary: We do not have AGI, more work is needed.
body_text: ARC Prize Foundation - a North Star for AGI Foreword from ARC Prize Co-founders Mike Knoop & François Chollet: ARC Prize launched in 2024 as an experiment to promote the relatively obscure, but important, ARC-AGI benchmark. Now, after our OpenAI o3 testing, nearly everyone in tech has heard of it. But there is much more work to do to reach AGI. There remains many things that are easy/fast for humans, but hard/slow for AI. Unlike most frontier AI benchmarks, we are not trying to measure AI risk with superhuman exam questions. Instead we are trying to inspire progress by promoting this gap in basic human capability. Future versions of the benchmark will focus on shrinking this gap towards zero. ARC Prize has been exclusively funded by us so far, and to do this work, we’re growing ARC Prize into a proper non-profit foundation to act as a useful north star toward AGI. We're excited to announce that Greg Kamradt, who co-led ARC Prize 2024, will be taking on the role of ARC Prize President and joining the board to lead this effort. ARC Prize 2024 Wrapped In June we launched ARC Prize, a $1M competition to open source a ARC-AGI solution, to redirect the AI community towards AGI progress. The result was, frankly, energy and momentum that we couldn’t have imagined. I want to talk about what’s coming up in 2025, but before that, let’s look back on what we accomplished in 2024. $1M Competition Over 1.4K teams submitted 17K entries in the 2024 Kaggle competition . At launch, our $1M prize pool was the largest on Kaggle. Though the Grand Prize of $600K was not unlocked, we awarded $75K to 3 outstanding research papers and $50K to the top 5 teams who had the highest score against the ARC-AGI Private Evaluation. Technical Paper & NeurIPS Highlight We documented 2024's conceptual progress through our technical paper . This paper was presented at NeurIPS during the System 2 Reasoning At Scale workshop by François Chollet. He shared the stage with renowned experts Joshua Tenenbaum , Melanie Mitchell , and Jason Weston . François Chollet at NeurIPS 2024. Media Spotlight We were grateful to collaborate with various media partners to help spread the work about ARC Prize and its mission. This included top AI podcasts Dwarkesh Patel , No Priors , and Machine and Learning Street Talk , Cognitive Revolution , and Sequoia Capital , as well as press outlets like Time , Nature , New Scientist , The Information , and Forbes . We also saw a number of community-generated videos dedicated to ARC-AGI . François Chollet & Dwarkesh Patel. Thriving Community As the community grows, so does ARC Prize. We wrapped 2024 with 3.4K Discord members, 15.4K Twitter followers, and 6.7K Newsletter subscribers. ARC Prize launch party. ARC Prize 2024 University Tour In Fall of ‘24, we visited 14 top AI Programs live on a US university tour ( recap video ). We also held a virtual event to share the tour with everyone. The final stop on the tour was a private gathering of top AI researchers at a private event co-hosted by a16z NYC . ARC Prize 2024 University Tour at NYU. AI Lab Focus In 2024 we became aware of at least 8 distinct efforts to solve ARC-AGI by organizations that have greater than $1M in funding, including Basis AI , Tufa Labs , Agemo , and Symbolica + four others in stealth. OpenAI o3 Live Stream We partnered with OpenAI to test their new o3 system against ARC-AGI-1 and joined the final livestream for "12 Days of OpenAI" to feature ARC Prize . Thank you to Sam and Mark for hosting us! Greg Kamradt joins OpenAI's announcement of o3. All of this impact was achieved with a small, self-funded team. Bryan Landers and I led the charge as co-leads, with invaluable support from Mike Knoop and François Chollet , who volunteered their time and expertise as competition hosts. 2025: ARC Prize Foundation Building on the momentum from 2024, we're evolving the ARC Prize Foundation to make ARC-AGI an academic, policy, and industry standard for measuring and guiding AGI. Our unique strengths are: Creating valuable, enduring benchmarks Deploying benchmarks within the AI community This combination enables us to have an outsized impact in the field. New Leadership To better align with this goal, I’m excited to announce a new leadership structure. I am proud to take on the role of President of the ARC Prize Foundation. In addition to this, I will join the non-profit board with Mike & François to help guide the mission and vision of our work. Expanding Our Impact Non-profit Status: We are transitioning to a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, which will allow us to accept tax-deductible donations. Lab Partnerships: We're actively forging partnerships with frontier AI research labs. These collaborations will involve participation in the development of ARC-AGI-2 & 3 and model/system evaluation through early test access. If your lab wants to get involved, contact us at team@arcprize.org. Academic Network: We're committed to fostering a strong academic network around the ARC Prize Foundation, connecting researchers, students, and institutions to collaborate on solving the biggest challenges of abstraction and reasoning in AI. Fundraising Initiatives: To support our expanded vision, we will be launching a fundraise initiative mid-January to further expand our reach. If you’d like to learn more, contact us at team@arcprize.org. Benchmark Evolution ARC-AGI-2: As we've previously shared , new, high-signal tasks are needed to further test the limits of AI reasoning abilities. This new dataset will be used in the 2025 competition. The updated benchmark and paper will be released in late Q1 2025. ARC-AGI-3 : We're already hard at work on ARC-AGI-3, which will depart from the current paradigm of ARC-AGI-1. We are working in collaboration with leading labs and researchers to develop this. If you're interested in participating, please reach out to team@arcprize.org. Get Involved We want you to join us on this journey to AGI - whether you're a researcher, developer, student, or simply passionate about AI, there are many ways to get involved. Participate in the 2025 Competition: Put your skills to the test and compete for prizes and recognition. Join the newsletter to hear about when this will go out! Contribute to the Community: Share your ideas, collaborate with peers, and help build a vibrant research ecosystem. Join YouTube , Twitter , and Discord . Make a donation to the ARC Prize Foundation: Want to help the ARC Prize Foundation do more? Contact team@arcprize.org for more information.

summary: Microsoft is revolutionizing file search in Windows 11 with a new AI-powered feature that uses semantic indexing for intuitive, natural language searching. Designed to work offline on specialized Copilot Plus PCs, this feature supports various file types and offers multi-language processing. Initially rolling out on Snapdragon devices, it promises to enhance efficiency and productivity without an internet connection. While celebrated for its technological advancements, the limited hardware support and privacy concerns spark intricate debates among users and experts alike.
body_text: Windows 11 Gets a Search Makeover with AI Smarts Microsoft's New AI-Powered Search for Windows 11 Redefines File Discovery Microsoft is revolutionizing file search in Windows 11 with a new AI‑powered feature that uses semantic indexing for intuitive, natural language searching. Designed to work offline on specialized Copilot Plus PCs, this feature supports various file types and offers multi‑language processing. Initially rolling out on Snapdragon devices, it promises to enhance efficiency and productivity without an internet connection. The introduction of a 'Refine' option adds grammar correction capabilities to the mix. While celebrated for its technological advancements, the limited hardware support and privacy concerns spark intricate debates among users and experts alike. Introduction to Microsoft's AI‑Powered Search Microsoft is pushing the boundaries of search technology with its latest innovation for Windows 11, an AI‑enhanced feature currently under testing . With this development , Microsoft aims to revolutionize how users interact with search functionalities on their devices. Unlike traditional search methods that rely heavily on exact keywords, this new feature makes use of semantic indexing, allowing it to understand the context and meaning of queries. This advancement enables more natural language searches, such as asking for "vacation photos" instead of sifting through cumbersome file names. One of the standout aspects of Microsoft's new AI search tool is its offline capability, powered by specialized Neural Processing Units (NPUs) present in Copilot Plus PCs. These NPUs allow complex AI features to be executed locally on the device, ensuring that users can benefit from robust search functions without needing an internet connection. This offline functionality extends to a range of file types, including JPEG, PNG, PDF, TXT, and XLS, broadening the usability and appeal of the tool. The initial rollout strategy is strategic, leveraging Snapdragon‑powered devices as the first recipients of this cutting- edge technology. Following this, Microsoft plans a phased expansion to include PCs running on Intel and AMD chips. This method not only diversifies the accessibility of the tool across hardware platforms but also addresses the widespread demand from users eager to experience these advancements firsthand. Moreover, the tool's support for multiple languages, including English, Chinese, German, French, Japanese, and Spanish, positions it as a globally accessible innovation. Complementing the search function is Microsoft's new "Refine" feature, integrated into the Click to Do menu. This addition focuses on enhancing user productivity by offering grammar correction for selected text, underscoring Microsoft's commitment to improving everyday user experiences. While still in development , these features highlight a significant step forward in leveraging AI for personal computing. Furthermore, the plan to integrate these capabilities with OneDrive cloud storage suggests a future where local and cloud resources are seamlessly interconnected, offering users a more unified experience. Semantic Indexing: Revolutionizing Search on Windows 11 Semantic indexing on Windows 11 is set to redefine the way users interact with their local files, bringing a host of advances driven by AI technology. Leveraging the capabilities of Neural Processing Units (NPUs), this innovative search feature allows for natural language queries, making it possible to search for files using everyday language rather than specific filenames. This development marks a significant shift away from conventional search methods, offering enhanced accessibility and efficiency for users worldwide. With support for a multitude of file formats including JPEG, PNG, PDF, TXT, and XLS, as well as multilingual capabilities, this feature promises to cater to a diverse user base. Microsoft's focus on offline functionality with the introduction of the Copilot Plus PCs, which house specialized NPUs, ensures that users can enjoy the benefits of AI‑powered search without relying on internet connectivity. This move is particularly advantageous for users in areas with limited internet access or those who prioritize data privacy. The phased rollout, prioritizing Snapdragon devices first, will later include Intel and AMD platforms, showcasing Microsoft's expansive vision for AI integration across different hardware specifications. However, the exclusivity of advanced features to Copilot Plus PCs raises concerns about a potential 'two‑tier' system, where only users with certain hardware setups can take full advantage of these innovations. This has sparked discussions among technology analysts and users alike about the potential for a widened digital divide. Despite this, public enthusiasm remains high for the semantic indexing capabilities, driven by its promise of more efficient file discovery and organization. The implications of integrating such a sophisticated AI feature extend beyond just practical convenience. As semantic search becomes more ubiquitous, it could reshape workplace productivity patterns by significantly reducing the time spent searching for documents. This efficiency opens new avenues for rethinking digital workflows and could set new standards for software development focused on user experience. Looking ahead, the push towards local AI processing might prompt tech companies to rethink their cloud service models, potentially reducing the dependency on cloud storage for file searching. This shift could stimulate more competition in the AI search domain, pushing hardware manufacturers and tech giants to innovate further. Moreover, as privacy concerns and regulations evolve to catch up with technological advancements, features like Recall will likely remain under intense scrutiny to ensure user safety and data security . Offline Functionality with Copilot Plus PCs Microsoft is pushing forward with innovative technology in their newest venture: offline functionality with Copilot Plus PCs. This initiative is centered around incorporating new AI‑powered search features into Windows 11. The integration leverages semantic indexing for heightened natural language search capabilities of local files, which means users can search for content using conversational queries rather than specific filenames. The offline functionality is made possible through Neural Processing Units (NPUs) in Copilot Plus PCs. These NPUs allow advanced AI operations, including natural language processing , to function without depending on internet connectivity. The significance of this feature is multifaceted: it not only enhances privacy and security by processing data locally, avoiding cloud‑based vulnerabilities, but it also ensures access to AI capabilities even in environments with limited or no internet access. Initially, this new feature has been rolled out on Snapdragon‑powered devices, with plans to expand its availability to Intel and AMD systems. This bodes well for varied hardware support in the future, although the current limitation has sparked some frustration among users who don't own Snapdragon devices. Moreover, Microsoft aims to expand these capabilities to include OneDrive cloud storage , promising a more integrated and extensive user experience. Copilot Plus computers support commonly used file types such as JPEG, PNG, PDF, TXT, and XLS, which broadens their utility across different user needs. Furthermore, the inclusion of multi‑language support—encompassing Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, and Spanish—positions Windows 11 as a globally accessible operating system , enhancing its appeal in international markets. This wide language support may also encourage users from diverse linguistic backgrounds to adopt and leverage the enhanced search capabilities of Copilot Plus PCs. In terms of user interaction, Microsoft introduces a "Refine" option within the Click to Do feature. This provides grammar correction for selected text, making it an essential tool for enhancing document workflow efficiency in educational and professional settings. As Windows 11 continues to evolve, integrating AI‑powered tools like this into everyday tasks is a testament to Microsoft's dedication to improving user experience and productivity . File Support and Multi‑Language Options Microsoft's new AI‑powered search capabilities in Windows 11 have ushered in significant advancements in file accessibility and user experience, specifically with the inclusion of file support for various formats and robust multi‑language options. The system supports a wide array of file types, including JPEG, PNG, PDF, TXT, and XLS, ensuring users can perform natural language searches across these formats with ease. A key highlight of the AI search feature is its extensive multi‑language support, which includes Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, and Spanish. This functionality not only broadens Microsoft's user base but also caters to the diverse linguistic needs of users worldwide. The incorporation of semantic indexing by the AI enhances this experience even further by understanding the context and meaning of queries, rather than merely matching keywords. Such innovations are poised to set a new standard in PC usability. The hardware prerequisites for these advancements are noteworthy, with the initial rollout being observed on Snapdragon‑powered devices, followed by those with Intel and AMD configurations. This strategic approach allows for a phased adoption, simultaneously addressing any significant technical challenges and accumulating user feedback to refine and enhance the search system further. Moreover, these advancements do not compromise on performance even when offline, thanks to the Neural Processing Units (NPUs) integrated into Copilot Plus PCs. This feature ensures that users can still access high‑speed, AI‑enhanced search capabilities without the need for constant internet connectivity. This ability is particularly valued in regions with limited internet access, driving appreciation and demand for such offline functionalities. Rollout Timeline and Platform Compatibility The rollout timeline for Microsoft's new AI‑powered search feature in Windows 11 is structured to begin with devices running on Snapdragon processors. This cautious, phased approach allows for rigorous testing in real‑world conditions to ensure performance stability and user satisfaction before expanding the availability to devices powered by Intel and AMD platforms. By initially focusing on Snapdragon devices, Microsoft can leverage optimized compatibility with the NPU chips included in Copilot Plus PCs, which are instrumental in supporting offline functionality. Platform compatibility is a critical aspect of Microsoft's rollout strategy for the new search feature in Windows 11. The initial support for Copilot Plus PCs suggests that Microsoft is keen on demonstrating the advanced capabilities unlocked by Neural Processing Units (NPUs), which enable the AI features to function seamlessly without an internet connection. This rollout highlights the distinction between Copilot Plus‑ready PCs and standard configurations, underscoring a potential shift towards premium hardware experiences. Expect gradual compatibility expansion across various hardware platforms, eventually encompassing Intel and AMD systems, allowing a broader range of users to experience the innovative search functionalities. The strategic introduction of multi‑language support for this new feature demonstrates Microsoft's commitment to creating a globally inclusive product. By offering languages such as Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, and Spanish from the start, Microsoft ensures the feature appeals to a diverse user base, enhancing the user experience across linguistic barriers. Consequently, this inclusivity not only broadens the feature's reach but also positions Windows 11 to potentially increase its market share in regions where these languages are prevalent, therefore improving its competitive stance against other operating systems. As part of Microsoft's long‑term vision, there are plans to extend the new search capabilities to include OneDrive cloud storage , offering users an integrated search experience across both local and cloud‑stored files. This integration is poised to transform the way users access and manage their files, providing a seamless transition between local storage and cloud environments. Furthermore, the expansion into cloud integration reflects an industry‑wide trend towards leveraging AI to enhance user interactions with digital content sources, striking a balance between local and internet‑based computing solutions. Understanding the New 'Refine' Feature The 'Refine' feature is a significant addition to Microsoft's suite of tools, allowing users unprecedented control over their text‑based interactions. This feature is part of the AI‑powered search capabilities integrated into Windows 11, which focuses on natural language processing and contextual understanding. With 'Refine', users can easily correct grammatical errors within any selected text, streamlining the editing process and enhancing document clarity. This enhancement is accessible through the Click to Do menu, a functionality that can be activated with a simple Windows key and left click. The innovation represents a shift towards more user‑friendly interfaces and intuitive design , as it minimizes the steps required to access advanced text‑processing features. Moreover, the 'Refine' feature underscores Microsoft's commitment to integrating AI into daily computing tasks, reducing the barrier between technology and its users. By automating grammar correction, it not only enhances productivity but also enables users to polish their communications effortlessly. This is particularly beneficial in professional settings where precision and tone are paramount. Aside from improving individual efficiency, the 'Refine' feature is a testament to the shift towards smarter, AI‑driven computing solutions that learn from user input and adapt accordingly. This adaptability ensures that the tool remains relevant and useful across various professional and linguistic contexts. Overall, the 'Refine' feature complements Microsoft's broader strategy of embedding AI functionalities within its platforms, offering users a seamless and enhanced computing experience. As AI continues to evolve, features like 'Refine' will likely become standard in many digital tools, setting new benchmarks for functionality and user interaction. Comparison with Other AI Search Initiatives Microsoft's foray into AI‑powered search with its latest Windows 11 feature is a remarkable stride in semantic search technology. This initiative is set apart by its use of semantic indexing and offline functionality enabled by specialized Neural Processing Units (NPUs), which isn't a common feature among AI search technologies. A significant advantage of Microsoft’s offering is the ability to process searches locally without requiring an internet connection, thereby ensuring faster query responses and enhanced privacy for users who prefer offline operations. In comparison to Meta's AI Search Integration, which was initiated across platforms like Facebook and Instagram, Microsoft's initiative appears more centered around personal file management rather than social media integration. Meta’s AI capabilities focus heavily on enhancing the search of visual content and improving contextual understanding for social interaction, whereas Microsoft's semantic search aims to simplify file retrieval and enhance personal productivity on a PC level. Amazon’s AI Shopping Assistant, known as Rufus, introduces another dimension by focusing more on retail AI capabilities such as visual search and personalized recommendations. Unlike Microsoft’s primarily productivity -focused AI, Amazon's venture is geared towards enhancing consumer shopping experiences by providing AI‑driven shopping assistance. This showcases the versatility with which AI is being integrated to cater to varied aspects of consumer life, from work‑related file searches to shopping and social networking . Anthropic 's release of Claude 3.0 marks another significant advancement in AI search initiatives comparable to Microsoft’s efforts. Claude 3.0 enhances real‑time data processing and promises more accurate retrieval of information , making it a direct competitor to Microsoft's search technology. However, the focus of Claude 3.0 remains more on real‑time information retrieval across larger data sets, which contrasts with Microsoft's more personalized and localized approach. Samsung's AI search features in the Galaxy S25 also bring a competitive edge by integrating advanced image recognition and cross- platform search functionalities, primarily targeting mobile device users. This positions Samsung’s AI initiative as more aligned with Meta’s approach that relies heavily on multimedia content search , unlike Microsoft’s emphasis on semantic file search within PC environments. Each of these AI initiatives reflects unique brand strategies and target markets. Microsoft's offline semantic search caters especially to users valuing privacy and productivity improvements in isolated computing environments. In contrast, Meta, Amazon, and Samsung provide AI solutions that are integrated into broader ecosystem enhancements, emphasizing either social media usability, retail efficiency, or mobile accessibility. This diversity underscores the multifaceted application of AI technologies across different sectors and user needs. Expert Opinions on AI Search Features Microsoft's new AI‑powered search feature in Windows 11 is a significant advancement in local search technology. Utilizing semantic indexing, this feature allows users to perform natural language searches on their local files, improving user experience by going beyond simple keyword matching to understanding the context and meaning of queries. This marks a substantial shift toward more intuitive and efficient file discovery. The technology's offline capability is one of its standout features. Enabled by specialized Neural Processing Units (NPUs) in Copilot Plus PCs, users can perform searches without an internet connection. This not only enhances accessibility for users who need to operate offline but also raises interesting implications for data privacy and security . Security experts have noted potential vulnerabilities, but the offline functionality is nonetheless a step forward in addressing connectivity limitations. Despite its promising features, the AI search function is currently available only on Snapdragons, with a phased rollout planned for Intel and AMD platforms. This limitation has raised concerns about creating a two‑tiered experience for Windows 11 users, where advanced features are restricted to high‑end hardware. Consequently, while many users applaud the integration of such advanced AI capabilities, there is notable frustration over the restricted hardware support. Public reactions are varied. Many users praise the semantic indexing and multi‑language support, which includes Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, and Spanish. However, some express discontent with the limited hardware compatibility and raise privacy concerns, particularly regarding the Recall feature, which involves screen snapshots and could have security implications. Despite this, the "Refine" grammar correction feature has been positively received, adding value through seamless contextual integration. Looking ahead, these developments in AI search technology present several implications. The concept of "AI‑capable" PCs is likely to become a premium category—this could intensify market segmentation and widen the digital divide among users based on hardware capabilities. Furthermore, the shift towards offline AI processing hints at potential changes in cloud computing models, as local processing reduces reliance on cloud services. Privacy regulations may also need to evolve to address these new technological paradigms and ensure data security . Public Reactions and Concerns The rollout of Microsoft's new AI‑powered search feature for Windows 11 has sparked a significant range of reactions and concerns among the public. One of the most notable reactions is the praise for the semantic indexing capabilities and natural language processing abilities of the new search feature. Many users have expressed their satisfaction with how the technology improves the efficiency of file discovery, making it easier to find documents and files without needing to remember exact file names. In addition, users have expressed appreciation for the offline functionality available on Copilot Plus PCs, which utilize Neural Processing Units (NPUs) to conduct searches without requiring an internet connection. This feature is particularly valued by those who prioritize data privacy and want to limit their dependency on cloud‑based services. However, there is also considerable frustration over the limited hardware support, as the feature currently excludes a majority of Intel and AMD systems, limiting access primarily to those with specialized Copilot Plus hardware configurations. Moreover, the public has shown a strong positive reaction to the multi‑language support, which includes major languages like Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, and Spanish. This capability broadens the accessibility of the feature to a more diverse user base. However, there is a demand for further expansion of language options to make the technology more globally inclusive. Aside from these positives, there are significant privacy concerns related to aspects of the new feature, particularly the Recall function, which involves screen snapshotting capabilities. Users are debating the balance between enhanced functionalities and the potential risks to privacy and data security , reflecting a division in the public's perception. Additionally, reactions to the new "Refine" grammar correction feature are generally favorable. Users appreciate its integration into the Windows interface, allowing for real‑time grammar corrections within text editors and other applications. The phased rollout schedule has also led to some impatience among potential users, with many eager for the feature's wider availability across different hardware platforms. This anticipation highlights a growing demand for advanced AI features in everyday technology use, but also underscores the frustration stemming from accessibility constraints. Future Implications of AI Search Technology The integration of AI‑powered search technology within Windows 11 marks a significant leap forward in personal computing, promising to redefine user interaction with digital content. This new development by Microsoft is particularly transformative due to its use of semantic indexing that allows for natural language processing , improving how users search for and retrieve files. The initial release on Snapdragon‑powered devices promises enhanced user experience, targeting tech‑savvy audiences who demand high‑performance computing. These capabilities are powered by new Neural Processing Units (NPUs), which provide offline functionality—a standout feature considering the contemporary landscape's over‑reliance on cloud infrastructure. The implications of these advancements in AI search technology extend well beyond mere user convenience. As PCs become more 'AI‑capable,' equipped with the necessary hardware like NPUs, we stand on the brink of a market segmentation where premium devices offer capabilities far surpassing those available in standard PCs. This division might not only cater to tech enthusiasts but could also lead to a broader digital divide, where access to cutting- edge technology is limited to those who can afford it. Simultaneously, the local processing capabilities suggest potential shifts in cloud computing paradigms, where reliance on cloud services might diminish as users handle more tasks locally. Furthermore, the widespread adoption of semantic search capabilities and AI‑based features could significantly alter productivity dynamics in both personal and professional settings. Enhanced search functionality means less time spent organizing files or struggling to find information , thus streamlining processes and increasing efficiency. As a result, workplaces might witness a notable transformation in operational models, adapting to tools that simplify tasks and boost employee productivity through intuitive search mechanisms. Educational and digital literacy programs may also need to evolve to integrate these new methodologies into curricula, ensuring learners are equipped to leverage these powerful tools. In addition, with Microsoft's expansion plans, including support for multiple languages and intended integration with OneDrive cloud storage , there is a clear focus on expanding market penetration globally. This could lead to more competitive dynamics in operating system markets regionally, particularly in areas where non‑English languages are predominant. However, these advancements also surface significant privacy concerns that need addressing, particularly around features like Recall, which could collect data locally without users being fully aware. It's crucial for privacy regulations and policies to evolve in tandem with these technological innovations, ensuring that user data is protected even as AI technologies advance. The introduction of these sophisticated search capabilities is expected to trigger a race among technology companies to innovate and introduce similar features in their own platforms. Companies that fail to adapt may find themselves lagging behind as market leaders like Microsoft push forward with pioneering AI solutions. The ongoing competition will likely foster a dynamic tech landscape with rapid‑paced advancements, compelling developers and engineers to enhance NPUs and other key technologies. This scenario envisions a future where AI is not just a peripheral technology, but a core component across devices and applications, influencing market shares significantly. title: 4 things to know about our acquisition of Axonics, Inc.
summary: Learn how it will help us reach more women with overactive bladder and other debilitating urological conditions.
body_text: When Meghan Scanlon chose mechanical engineering as her college major, she didn’t have a particular career path in mind. But when she learned about the medical device industry while in graduate school, she never looked back. As senior vice president and president of the Urology business at Boston Scientific, Scanlon says she’s happy to have found a field that combines the problem-solving of engineering with the opportunity to make a real impact on the lives of people around the world. “I like surgical procedures because they’re typically mechanical solutions to problems that can be seen and touched,” she says. “And fields like urology offer unique opportunities for making the lives of health care providers and their patients easier through innovation.” The newest opportunity she has her sights on: Reaching as many of the estimated 30 million U.S. adults suffering from overactive bladder as possible. We asked Scanlon to share how Boston Scientific is poised to do just that, thanks to the recent acquisition of Axonics, Inc. What is the mission of the Urology business at Boston Scientific? Everything we do is about making sure our innovations, investments and programs advance care for patients around the world suffering from urological conditions like benign prostatic hyperplasia , male and female incontinence, erectile dysfunction and kidney stones . How did Axonics first appear on your radar? As part of our strategy to remain a category leader in urology, we pay close attention to portfolio adjacencies that we don't yet participate in. Sometimes we can develop technologies in-house to address those gaps. Other times, our strength and strategy in executing acquisitions allows us to continue to diversify our business. Axonics offers implantable devices, including those that treat overactive bladder. Axonics is known for their implantable devices to help treat people suffering from overactive bladder , an umbrella term that includes the frequent and urgent need to empty the bladder, and fecal incontinence , also known as accidental bowel leakage. The Axonics portfolio also includes a bulking therapy to help women with stress urinary incontinence , or the unintentional passing of urine due to exertion or an activity, like coughing, laughing or exercising. Before the acquisition, many of the products in our portfolio primarily addressed urological issues with the male anatomy. With the addition of Axonics technologies, we now offer more devices to treat the female anatomy, which is really exciting. What are your hopes for growing these technologies down the road? Startup companies like Axonics can do a really good job of bringing their innovations into the U.S. medical device marketplace. And while they may have goals to expand internationally, that's typically a longer and more complicated journey for a smaller company. Boston Scientific brings a full, mature ecosystem of commercial and health economics expertise that will serve as a springboard for the long-term growth of Axonics technologies globally. We look forward to offering these innovations to more patients around the world. You have been involved in more than a dozen company acquisitions throughout your career, and you clearly have such passion for it. What keeps you excited? Each acquisition is different—if you've seen one, you've seen one. Company cultures are different, technologies are different, portfolio complexity is different. I really enjoy welcoming new team members to the Boston Scientific organization and the Urology team. I also love learning from the people who join our company and having how that positively influences our culture. Our Urology business has been built through both organic, in-house innovation and acquisitions, and it’s because of our new teammates and ways of working that we continue to evolve and get stronger as an organization. Learn more about our innovative treatments for common urological conditions.

body_text: 델타항공, AI 기반 ‘멀티모달’ 교통 옵션으로 새로운 여행 경험 제시 델타항공은 지난 7일(현지시간) 라스베가스에서 열린 CES 2025 오프닝 기조연설에서, 인공지능(AI) 기반 디지털 서비스 ‘델타 컨시어지(Delta Concierge)’를 공개하며 고객의 여정이 처음부터 끝까지 연결되는 미래 ‘멀티모달’ 여행의 청사진을 밝혔다. Staff Writer Jan 10, 2025 11:30am 델타항공은 지난 7일(현지시간) 라스베가스에서 열린 CES 2025 오프닝 기조연설에서, 인공지능(AI) 기반 디지털 서비스 ‘델타 컨시어지(Delta Concierge)’를 공개하며 고객의 여정이 처음부터 끝까지 연결되는 미래 ‘멀티모달’ 여행의 청사진을 밝혔다. 델타 컨시어지는 플라이 델타(Fly Delta) 앱에 내장된 디지털 도구로, 고객의 여정이 매 단계에서 더욱 의미있게 연결될 수 있도록 개인화된 맞춤형 정보와 여행 경험을 제공한다. 생성형 AI 기술을 활용하여 개인 비서처럼 고객의 여행을 더욱 편리하게 관리해주는 것이 특징이다. 델타항공은 지난 CES 2020에서 '컨시어지' 컨셉을 공개하며 원활하고 스트레스 없는 미래의 여행을 선보였다. 델타 컨시어지 서비스는 금년부터 제공될 예정이다. 델타항공은 다양한 파트너십을 통해 델타 컨시어지 서비스를 새롭게 발표한 멀티모달 여행 옵션에 적극 활용할 계획이다. 델타항공은 차량 및 배달 서비스 제공업체인 우버(Uber)와 새로운 파트너십 체결과 전기 항공 택시 서비스 제공업체인 조비(Joby)와의 파트너십 강화를 발표했다. 델타항공은 델타 컨시어지 서비스를 우버 및 조비와 연동해 고객에 보다 원활한 여행의 새로운 방식을 제공한다. 에드 바스티안(Ed Bastian) 델타항공 최고경영자(CEO)는 CES 2025 기조연설 무대에서 “델타항공은 플라이 델타 앱을 시작으로 디지털 및 물리적 경험을 결합하기 위한 새로운 방식을 고민한다”며 “세계에서 가장 신뢰받는 항공사로서 쌓아온 인사이트를 바탕으로 고객이 어떤 사람인지, 어떤 여행 스타일을 선호하는지 맥락을 파악해 AI 기반 개인 비서 서비스를 제공하는 것이 델타 컨시어지의 비전”이라고 밝혔다. 델타 컨시어지 AI, 델타항공 프리미엄 멤버십 회원 전용 여정 지원 델타항공은 AI와 데이터를 활용하여 새로운 방식으로 고객 충성도를 구축하고, 여행 중과 여행 외의 상황에서 항공사가 고객과 소통하는 방식을 바꾸고 있다. 고객은 자연어 텍스트 또는 음성 입력을 사용하여 델타 컨시어지와 소통이 가능하다. 해당 도구는 궁극적으로 ▲고객의 요구를 실시간으로 예측하고, ▲상황에 맞는 안내를 제공하며, ▲고객을 대신하여 조치를 취하는 역할을 한다. 델타 컨시어지가 향후 고객을 위해 어떤 역할을 하게 될지에 대해 아래 사례를 통해 살펴볼 수 있다. (항공권 부킹 단계) 델타 컨시어지 AI 어시스턴트는 고객을 대신하여 도착 및 출발 요구 사항을 더 잘 이해하고 시간과 스트레스를 절약하는 효율성을 창출한다. 이는 고객이 여정 중 스카이마일스(SkyMiles) 멤버십의 모든 혜택을 누릴 수 있도록 하는 것과 밀접하다. (여행 준비 단계) 델타 컨시어지는 고객의 여행 계획을 더욱 직관적으로 세우며 여행 준비의 모든 단계에서 관련 정보를 제공한다. 델타 컨시어지는 올해부터 각 고객에게 다가오는 여권 만료 및 비자 요건에 대해 알려주는 서비스를 제공한다. 몇 년 후에는 기상 상황 업데이트와 같은 여행 목적지에 대한 유용한 알림을 제공하여 도움을 줄 계획이다. (공항 도착 단계) 델타 컨시어지는 고객에 미리 수하물을 맡기는 곳, 델타 스카이 클럽과 탑승구의 위치까지 가는 길을 사전에 고객에 알려줌으로써 여행객이 낯선 공항에서 헤매지 않도록 도와준다. 또한 신속한 보안 검색을 위한 전용 TSA PreCheck® 터치리스 ID 라인이 언제 있는지 알려주며, 고객의 시간을 절약해준다. (비행기 탑승 단계) 향후 출시될 델타 컨시어지 서비스는 고객이 스카이마일스(SkyMiles) 멤버십을 통해 업계 최고의 개인 맞춤형 기내 엔터테인먼트 경험인 ‘델타싱크 와이파이’와 ‘델타싱크 시트백’에 자동으로 연결할 수 있도록 지원한다. 이는 고객의 시간을 절약하기 위해 고안된 것으로, 고객이 원하는 방식으로 여행을 보낼 수 있는 고급스럽고 개인적인 순간을 제공한다. *참고: CES 2025에서 발표된 2025년 델타싱크 개선 사항 파트너사 협업 통한 새로운 형태의 원활한 멤버십 연계 ‘멀티모달’ 여행 모드 개발 델타항공은 파트너사와 긴밀한 협업 및 통합을 통해 단일 고객 여정이 처음부터 끝까지 연결되는 미래 멀티모달 여행에 대한 청사진을 밝혔다. 특히, 델타 컨시어지 서비스는 고객의 요구와 선호도를 파악하여 향후 몇 년 안에 다가올 커넥티드 여행의 생태계에서 고객에게 가장 적합한 여행 경로를 제공할 것으로 기대된다. 멀티모달 여행을 향한 델타항공의 의지는 당사의 파트너십에서도 나타난다. 델타항공은 우버와 새로운 파트너십을 체결하며 고객이 우버 와 스카이마일스(SkyMiles) 계정을 연결하고, 해당되는 차량 및 배달 서비스에 대한 마일리지를 적립할 수 있도록 하겠다고 밝혔다. 스카이마일스(SkyMiles) 회원은 공항을 오가는 UberX 차량 서비스 이용 시 1달러당 1마일, 프리미엄 차량 서비스 이용 시 1달러당 2마일, Uber Reserve 차량 서비스 이용 시 1달러당 3마일을 적립할 수 있다. 또한 적격 식당 및 식료품 배달주문에 사용한 1달러당 1마일이 적립된다. 해당 서비스는 올해 봄부터 지원될 예정이다. 특히, 전체 우버 차량 예약의 15% 이상이 공항에서 시작하거나 끝나는 만큼, 이번 파트너십은 델타항공이 일상에서 사랑받는 브랜드 및 기업과의 협업을 통해 출발지에서 목적지까지의 여행의 커넥티비티를 제공하려는 노력을 강조한다. 에드 바스티안 델타항공 CEO는 ““델타항공은 처음부터 끝까지 연결된 여행 경험을 제공하기 위해 혁신적인 기술과 파트너십을 결합하고 있다"라며, “이를 통해 고객들은 자신에게 가장 적합한 방식으로 목적지에 도착할 수 있는 더 많은 선택권을 갖게 될 것”라고 전했다. 한편, 델타 컨시어지 서비스는 링크 를 통해 대기자 명단에 등록하여 사전등록을 할 수 있다. 계정을 연결하면 마일리지 적립과 대기자 전용 특별 혜택을 얻을 수 있다. 델타 컨시어지 서비스 관련 파트너십 및 출시일에 대한 자세한 내용은 향후 몇 주 내에 공유될 예정이다. 이 밖에, 델타 컨시어지는 집에서 공항까지 이동하는 여행 경험을 변화시킬 조비의 전기 에어택시 서비스 와도 연계될 계획이다. 조비는 승차 공유의 편리함과 경제성을 비행의 힘과 결합하여 깨끗하고 지속가능함과 동시에, 조용하고 저렴한 항공 여행을 일상적인 현실로 만들 계획이다. 한편, 델타항공과 조비는 지난 2022년에 파트너십을 발표했으며 연방 및 지역 당국의 승인을 기다리는 동안 수년 내에 델타항공의 뉴욕(LGA 및 JFK) 및 로스앤젤레스(LAX) 허브에서 운영을 런칭할 예정이다. title: Electrolyte Sensing Enabling Early Detection & Prevention of Thermal Runaway
summary: Early detection of thermal runaway in EVs through electrolyte vapor sensing ensures fire prevention and safety. Learn more about Honeywell's innovative sensing solutions.
body_text: January 20, 2025 Despite progress in cell chemistry and Battery Management Systems, fire incidents persist. IDTechEx* reports that about a third of EV fires happen when the vehicle is parked and not charging. EV fires cause significant damage to garages and surrounding vehicles, and there is a concern that these fires can reignite several days after being extinguished. This poses a serious public safety risk that requires immediate attention and preventative measures. EARLY DETECTION & PREVENTION OF THERMAL RUNAWAY Lithium batteries have flammable electrolytes that catch fire when subjected to excessive abuse such as thermal, electrical or mechanical abuse. The fire generated by one Li-ion battery cell can spread and trigger a chain reaction in nearby cells, leading to an irreversible and uncontrollable fire. Detecting the first vent which is the early release of electrolyte vapor may enable early detection and prevention of thermal runaway. Battery cell abuse may create an increase in the internal temperature of a lithium-ion cell, leading to the breakdown of organic electrolyte solvents. As the temperature rises, the electrolyte within the cell begins to gasify. This gasification phase results in a build-up of pressure inside the cell, elevating the temperature beyond the flashpoint. As the temperature continues to escalate, the separator material melts, creating a direct short circuit between the anode and cathode. The resulting electrical discharge can ignite the gases, leading to a fire. This fire can quickly escalate, igniting the electrodes and producing an intense fire with high temperatures. Furthermore, the combustion process releases hazardous gases such as hydrogen (H2), carbon monoxide (CO), and carbon dioxide (CO2) As electrolytes are vented first prior to the fire, sensing these electrolyte vapors ensures early detection of thermal runaway and opens avenues to prevent fire. As shown, one third of EV fires occur when the vehicle is charging. Over a period, overcharging can happen due to cumulative error, failure of the battery management system, improper cell balancing etc. The test case below shows how electrolyte vapor sensing can help prevent thermal runaway for such a failure mode presented by Honeywell at the 2024 North America Battery Show in Detroit, MI. In this test, a pouch cell is abused by overcharging at 2C rate. Once the electrolyte sensor alarm is triggered, the charging is turned off Cell cools down and thermal runaway is prevented The Battery Electrolyte Sensor (BES) successfully detected signs of thermal runaway at an early stage, i.e. the release of electrolyte vapors, enabling the activation of a safety protocol. This protocol involved disconnecting the charging source, which effectively halted the progression of the thermal runaway process and mitigated potential hazards. *Reference – Dr James Edmondson, EV Fires: Less Common But More Problematic? (2022) As electrolyte vapors are released during the early stages of thermal runaway, detecting the presence of electrolyte vapors within the lithium-ion battery pack presents a crucial opportunity to activate a safety protocol which can help arrest the progression of thermal runaway. This safety protocol may involve removing the source of abuse such as overcharging and thermal abuse. By taking these measures, overall vehicle and passenger safety can be significantly enhanced. Honeywell Sensing Solutions provides a comprehensive portfolio of advanced sensing, switching, and test & measurement technologies designed to meet the diverse needs of industries such as healthcare, transportation, industrial automation, and electric vehicles. With a focus on precision and reliability, these solutions enable optimized performance across critical applications. Supported by a team of expert engineers, Honeywell ensures personalized and innovative approaches, working collaboratively with customers to deliver tailored solutions that meet their specific requirements and performance standards, driving efficiency and ensuring long-term operational success. title: How AI Grounding Makes Mobile Testing Reliable
summary: Deep dive into how Revyl uses AI grounding to accurately identify and interact with UI elements, even when layouts change.
body_text: Understanding AI Grounding in Mobile Testing Traditional automated testing relies on fragile element selectors that break when UIs change. Revyl takes a different approach using AI grounding. What is AI Grounding? AI grounding is the process of connecting natural language instructions to specific UI elements on screen. When you say “tap the login button,” our AI: Captures the current screen state Identifies all interactive elements Maps your instruction to the most relevant element Executes the action with precision Why This Matters Resilience to UI Changes When a developer moves a button or changes its text from “Login” to “Sign In,” traditional tests break. AI-grounded tests understand intent, not just selectors. Natural Language Interface Write tests the way you think about them: “Scroll down until you see the Subscribe button” “Type ‘ hello@example.com ’ in the email field” “Verify the success message appears” Cross-Platform Consistency The same natural language test works on both Android and iOS, even though the underlying UI structures differ. The Technical Stack Revyl’s grounding pipeline uses: Vision models for screen understanding BAML for structured LLM interactions Platform-specific automation (UIAutomator2, XCTest) for reliable execution Results in Practice Our customers see: 80% reduction in test maintenance 3x faster test creation Higher confidence in test reliability Stay tuned for more deep dives into our technology stack.

title: Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited Announces Closing of Approximately $6 Million Initial Public Offering
summary: Dominari Securities is dedicated to helping clients preserve, grow and create new wealth by providing a full range investment advisory and wealth planning services.
body_text: Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited (Nasdaq: SKBL) has successfully closed its initial public offering of 1.5 million Class A ordinary shares at $4.00 per share, raising approximately $6 million before underwriting fees. Hong Kong, Jan. 24, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited (NASDAQ: SKBL) (the “Company”), a civil engineering services provider in Hong Kong, today announced the closing of its initial public offering (“Offering”) of 1,500,000 Class A ordinary shares at a public offering price of $4.00 per share, for total gross proceeds of $6 million to the Company before underwriting discounts and commissions. Proceeds from the Offering will be used to enhance the Company’s capacities in hiring additional staff, strengthen its market position in the civil engineering industry, acquire machinery to enhance its capacity, enhance the Company’s brand, as well as to fund working capital and for other general corporate purposes. All of the Class A Ordinary Shares are offered by the Company. The Offering closed on January 24, 2025 and the Class A Ordinary Shares commenced trading on Nasdaq Capital Market on January 23, 2025 under the ticker symbol “SKBL.” The Company has granted the Underwriters an option to purchase up to 225,000 additional Class A Ordinary Shares within 45 days of the effective date of the Company’s registration statement in relation to the Offering. The Offering was conducted on a firm commitment basis. Dominari Securities LLC acted as representative of the underwriters with Revere Securities LLC acted as co-underwriter (collectively, the “Underwriters”) for the Offering. Loeb & Loeb LLP acted as counsel to the Company, and Sichenzia Ross Ference Carmel LLP acted as counsel to the Underwriters in connection with the Offering. A registration statement on Form F-1 relating to the Offering was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) (File Number: 333-282720) and was declared effective by the SEC on December 31, 2024. The Offering was made only by means of a prospectus, forming a part of the registration statement. Copies of the final prospectus relating to the Offering may be obtained from Dominari Securities LLC, 725 Fifth Avenue, 23rd Floor, New York, NY 10022. In addition, a copy of the prospectus relating to the Offering may be obtained via the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov. Before you invest, you should read the prospectus and other documents the Company has filed or will file with the SEC for more complete information about the Company and the Offering. This press release does not constitute an offer to sell, or the solicitation of an offer to buy any of the Company’s securities, nor shall such securities be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration, nor shall there be any offer, solicitation, or sale of any of the Company’s securities in any state or jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation, or sale would be unlawful prior to registration or qualification under the securities laws of such state or jurisdiction. About Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited operates as an Approved Public Works Contractor undertaking roads and drainage to its customers in Hong Kong. Its construction activities mainly include public civil engineering works, such as road and drainage works, in Hong Kong. It mostly undertakes civil engineering works in the role of subcontractor, while it is also fully qualified to undertake such works in the capacity of main contractor. The Company’s public sector projects mainly involve infrastructure developments while private sector projects mainly involved residential and commercial developments. title: Why Your Data is Already AI-Ready
summary: How LLMs let you automate workflows with messy data today.
body_text: "We can't use AI yet—our data is a mess." We hear this from manufacturing CIOs every week. They have a 3-year roadmap to clean their ERP data, standardize SKUs, and digitize legacy TDS/MSDS documents before they even consider automation. Here is the secret they are missing: Large Language Models (LLMs) don't care if your data is messy. In fact, the ability to work with unstructured, dirty data is exactly what makes them useful. The "Perfect Data" Trap In the era of traditional software, "Garbage In, Garbage Out" was the golden rule. If your inventory system listed a product as "ACETONE_DRUM_200L" and a customer ordered "Acetone 200L Drum", the software would fail. It required an exact string match. This limitation forced companies into multi-year Master Data Management (MDM) projects. They spent millions hiring consultants to manually standardize descriptions, cleanse columns, and merge duplicate records. The Reality Check By the time these data cleanup projects finish, the business has changed. New products have launched, new suppliers have been onboarded, and the data is dirty again. It is a treadmill that never stops. LLMs as Universal Translators LLMs fundamentally change this equation because they operate on semantic meaning , not strict syntax. An AI agent doesn't look for an exact match; it looks for the concept. Context Awareness An agent knows that "IPA", "Iso-Propyl Alcohol", and "Isopropanol" refer to the same molecule. It doesn't need a lookup table; it has general chemical knowledge. Fuzzy Logic at Scale When a customer asks for "The food grade phosphoric acid we bought last year," a traditional query fails. An LLM agent looks at purchase history, filters for "acid," checks the specs for "food grade" or "85%," and finds the SKU. Skip the Cleanup Project Instead of cleaning your data at rest (which is expensive and slow), you can use AI to clean it at runtime . When an RFQ comes in, the AI agent acts as a translation layer. It takes the messy customer request, looks at your messy ERP data, and bridges the gap instantly. It creates a "virtual" clean dataset for that specific transaction, without you having to modify the underlying database.
